interface.signature: def isScramble(S1: str, S2: str) -> bool:

preconditions.description: The lengths of S1 and S2 are equal.
The length of S1 and S2 is between 1 and 31, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in S1) and all(c.islower() for c in S2)
preconditions.description: Both S1 and S2 consist of lower-case English letters only.

postconditions.expression: result == (S2 is a scrambled form of S1)
postconditions.description: The function returns True if S2 is a scrambled form of S1, otherwise False.
